description: Elections Commission - Notice for Local Authorities in Polonnaruwa District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Notice of Poll for local authorities elections in Polonnaruwa District, specifying the election date (March 09, 2023) and polling hours (7:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.), along with the list of local authorities where elections will be contested. This falls squarely under Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it deals with electoral processes and scheduling.
